name: カレンダー接続の説明と会議の予定を並べる管理ウィジェット
prompt:
Edit the existing LH09-0244 calendar card. The source crop is the visual authority; the Japanese mock only guides the translated wording. Preserve the current canvas proportions, complete rounded card boundary, center divider, left/right column widths, icon positions, text placement, event-row spacing, exact Japanese copy, two events, join-action pill, and blue link placement. The current v001 geometry closely matches the 964x339 source crop, so keep that geometry unchanged.

Make one targeted visual correction: soften the text and icon contrast to match the original screenshot's visibly pale, subdued treatment. The current candidate is too dark and bold. Use light neutral-gray titles, body, dates and event details at the same subdued level seen in the source crop, with medium-weight rather than heavy titles. Keep the small calendar/page icon and camera icon similarly pale. Keep all text legible. Change only the link's blue from the current vivid blue to the softer medium blue visible in the original source. Do not use the Japanese mock's darker text or green link color.

Preserve the exact text and content: 「会議メモとカレンダーの予定を接続」; 「会議へ参加し、記録して要約します。」; 「会議の情報を一つの場所へまとめます。」; blue link 「カレンダーを接続」; first event 「今日」「7月9日」「チームの朝会」「9時 · 事務所」 and camera action 「参加してメモを取る」; second event 「木曜日」「7月10日」「案件の確認」「10時 · 事務所」. Maintain the original two-column layout and faint vertical separators. Do not add a connected-account state, extra events, icons or content.
reviewNotes: v002 softens the first candidate, and the 2115x744 aspect 2.8427:1 matches the 964x339 source crop 2.8437:1. Geometry, two event rows and Japanese copy were checked. Residual title/event-text weight and contrast remain slightly too strong and the link blue is slightly pale, so retain as needs-correction after two attempts.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
